title: I’m building an anime action RPG almost entirely with AI. Here’s the trailer
author: Junin2233
selftext:
>Hey everyone! This is **OVERLIMIT**, an action RPG inspired by the anime fighting shows I grew up watching. I’m a solo dev, and almost all of the code was written with **Claude (Claude Code)**. I describe what I want, playtest it, and keep telling it what feels wrong until it clicks. The trailer music was made with **Suno**.  
>  
>**What I think is cool about it:**  
>  
>  
>  
>A free demo is coming soon on [itch.io](http://itch.io), and I plan to finish the full game for Steam.  
>  
>Question for anyone making bigger games with AI: **how do you stop the AI from doing unnecessary work**, like rewriting things that already worked? Would love your feedback too! 🙏
